description: The bar chart titled “Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment” illustrates the runtime (in seconds) for five models/frameworks in a streaming setting. The horizontal axis contains the categorical model names, ordered left to right as “Our Joint Framework,” “ChatGPT,” “DeepSeek,” “LLaMA,” and “Claude,” with labels shown at a slight angle; the vertical axis is labeled “Runtime (seconds)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400 with regularly spaced tick marks every 50 seconds. There are five vertical bars: “Our Joint Framework” is shown in dark green with an annotated value of 77 seconds; the remaining four bars are light blue (corresponding to the legend label “LLM Models”) with annotated values of 190 seconds for “ChatGPT,” 365 seconds for “DeepSeek,” 172 seconds for “LLaMA,” and 243 seconds for “Claude.” A legend in the upper-left distinguishes the dark green bar from the light blue LLM model bars, and each bar has its numeric runtime printed above it; the bars are not displayed as grouped or stacked, and no explicit sorting (e.g., ascending/descending) is indicated beyond the left-to-right category order.
